dedupe_keys.name: italo high speed rail and connecting bus gtfs conversion

description: This repository publishes a GTFS package for Italo high-speed rail and connecting-bus services, derived from official NeTEx timetables listed at Italy’s national access point. Its README documents train and bus route types, stops, operational calendars and a weekly Monday generation workflow. The converter uses a pinned NeTEx-to-GTFS submodule and adds calendar reconstruction, chronological stop sorting, trip names and feed metadata. The author reports correcting 683 upstream stop-order anomalies, but this review did not run the validator or inspect the ZIP. The repository licence is CC BY 4.0 for its GTFS dataset and generator code, while the upstream access-point terms should be checked for any redistribution beyond the derivative grant. Coverage is Italo’s national Italian services in the published NeTEx feed, not all Italian rail operators. The cited national-access-point page returned HTTP 500 during this check, so current raw feed availability was not independently confirmed. Simulation use includes scheduled train and feeder-bus connectivity, journey times and service-capacity scenarios. It complements data-transitland as an operator-specific prepared feed. The claimed weekly freshness is from project documentation, not verified from file contents.
licence: CC BY 4.0 for the published GTFS and generator; upstream NeTEx terms separate.
